phases.name: A placenta in the way out
phases.shows: Basic concept · The placenta should implant in the upper uterus, away from the cervix. In placenta praevia it lies over the internal os, the only way out for the baby. Covers: The idea; How it's defined today.

phases.name: Why the placenta implants low
phases.shows: Risk factors · Where the placenta ends up depends on where the blastocyst implants, and on where the lining gives it the best blood supply as it grows. Covers: The mechanism; Risk factors to quote.

phases.name: The lower segment grows, so the placenta seems to move
phases.shows: Week by week · The placenta stays attached in the same place, but the tissue under it grows. Covers: What you're seeing; So the scan schedule is.

phases.name: Painless, bright-red and recurrent
phases.shows: Antepartum haemorrhage · As the lower segment forms and the cervix starts to efface, the wall under the placenta stretches. The placenta cannot stretch with it. Covers: The mechanism; Typical picture; Praevia vs abruption vs vasa praevia.

phases.name: Diagnose it without a finger
phases.shows: Examination · In any antepartum bleed, assume praevia until the placenta has been located. That changes how you examine. Covers: What to do.

phases.name: The first hour
phases.shows: Antepartum haemorrhage · The pathway and the orders update together. Covers: Every bleed, straight away; If she is shocked or the bleed is massive; If she is stable; Orders now.

phases.name: Expectant care, laid out across the weeks
phases.shows: Weeks 20 → 37 · Once she is stable, the aim is to gain fetal maturity safely and then deliver in a planned way, before labour or a big bleed forces it. The lens lays the plan out by week. Covers: Where she should be; While she waits; When to deliver (planned caesarean).

phases.name: Each drug, and where it acts
phases.shows: Doses · The ring on the pelvis shows where it acts, and the tray shows its first 48 hours. Covers: Antenatal drugs in praevia.

phases.name: A planned caesarean, planned around the placenta
phases.shows: Planned delivery · If the placenta covers the os, the baby can't pass through it, so birth is by caesarean. Covers: Mode of birth; Who and what must be ready; The incision.

phases.name: Why it keeps bleeding, and how to stop it
phases.shows: After the placenta · After the placenta comes out, the bed it leaves is in the lower segment . Normally the muscle fibres around the open vessels clamp them shut ("living ligatures"). Covers: Watch the lens; Doses, in order.

phases.name: Placenta accreta spectrum
phases.shows: The dangerous partner · On a caesarean scar the decidua is missing. Nothing stops the villi from growing into the muscle, so the placenta cannot separate at birth. Covers: The spectrum; Who to screen; Management.

parts.name: Placenta
parts.shows: Implanted over or near the internal os; its edge-to-os distance on TVS decides low-lying vs praevia

parts.name: Cervix and internal os
parts.shows: The way out; the placental edge is measured to the internal os

parts.name: Uterine wall
parts.shows: Upper segment muscle that contracts; the thin lower segment that forms from 28 weeks and clamps vessels poorly

parts.name: Caesarean scar
parts.shows: Scarred lower segment: raises the risk of praevia and of accreta when the placenta lies over it

parts.name: Fetus
parts.shows: High head or abnormal lie because the placenta occupies the pelvis; target of steroids and MgSO4

parts.name: Bleeding
parts.shows: Maternal blood from sheared placental bed, tracking out through the os: painless, bright red

parts.name: Transvaginal probe
parts.shows: Sits 2-3 cm from the cervix, never in the os: the safe and most accurate test

parts.name: Bakri balloon
parts.shows: Intrauterine tamponade pressing on the lower-segment placental bed after delivery

parts.name: Invading villi
parts.shows: Placenta accreta spectrum: villi grow into or through the myometrium at the scar

parts.name: Bladder
parts.shows: In front of the lower segment; invaded in percreta

parts.name: Vagina
parts.shows: Bleeding shows here; a finger must not go through the os

parts.name: Abdominal wall
parts.shows: Skin, fat and rectus over the growing uterus
